name: Speedcast
summary: Global satellite communications provider (Speedcast International, ASX:SDA) that supplied satellite backhaul to the Christmas Island ISP CIIA from 2015 (SES O3b MEO), then took over running Christmas Island's wireless/4G internet from Mar 2017 after CIIA's closure, operating until Oct 2021.

events.details: Supplied O3b trunking/backhaul for the Christmas Island ISP CIIA, delivering the island's first true broadband.
Assumed operation of Christmas Island's wireless/4G internet after CIIA's closure (interim govt agreement).
